messages:
Laura Chen: Heads-up — we're scheduling a pre-dawn maintenance window in apac1 for NIC thermal calibration and a safe rolling reboot 03:00-05:00 UTC. Cohorted drains, no full-pool outage. I want runbook ack and tenant-priority plan by EOD.
Mike V: ACK. which pools are in-scope?
Laura Chen: Saturn & Zephyr racks (apac1-edge). We'll do 10 racks over the 2h window, 6m drain per rack + 8m cooldown backfill. Estimated throughput hit ~8% during peak of the operation.
Anil Patel: Paging priority list now — can we push low-cost batch jobs off the pool beforehand?
Laura Chen: Yes — flagging low-priority tenants for displacement. Jordan, can you run the preheat for kv-cache seeds 45m before each rack drain?
Jordan: Yep. I'll kick cache-seed in cohorts. Command I'll run:```scripts/kv-seed --region apac1 --cohort $COHORT --timeout 1800```
Sarah J: How are we handling egress-sensitive tenants? we still need to keep a small warm pool for them.
Laura Chen: Good call. We're reserving 12 GPUs across dedicated racks for egress-sensitive traffic and setting routing policy to prefer eu/hosted fallback if latency allows.
Mike V: Cost question — any extra burn from the reserved warm pool? ballpark?
Anil Patel: Rough calc: warm pool (12 GPUs) for 2h ~= 24 GPU-hours. With our rates that's ~ $X00 (will tag exact in the doc).
ops-bot: maintenance-created: id=maint-7012468000 region=apac1 window=03:00-05:00UTC cohorts=10 notify=on
deploy-bot: rolling-reboot job queued: job_id=rr-7012468000. Expected duration 110m.
Laura Chen: Runbook snippet (for those on-call):```# drain node example
kubectl drain node-apac1-zz-42 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --grace-period=60
# wait for pods to re-schedule and kv-cache prime
# run thermal check: /usr/local/bin/nic-thermal-check --node node-apac1-zz-42
# reboot and verify
reboot node-apac1-zz-42 && sleep 30 && /usr/local/bin/healthcheck node-apac1-zz-42
```
Sarah J: If any rack shows persistent NIC thermal > 85C during verification, abort cohort and escalate to hw-team.
Laura Chen: Agreed. Escalation path: ops on-call -> hw-team -> infra-lead. I'll open HW ticket template now.
Mike V: Network note: coordinate with netops to avoid BGP flaps when we pull egress routes off drained racks. @Anil please sync with @netops on the migration window.
Anil Patel: Pinged netops DM, they asked for a 5m heads-up per rack before we move egress. I'll add that to the timeline.
Jordan: I'll add a soft rate-limit step for bursty tenants during each cohort to keep queues stable:```tc qdisc replace dev eth0 root tbf rate 1gbit burst 100kb latency 50ms```
Laura Chen: Timeline in brief: 02:15 - preheat kv-cache cohort 1; 02:45 - reserve warm-pool; 03:00 - start cohort 1 drain; cohorts repeat every 12m. Final cohort completes ~04:54.
Laura Chen: I'll post the full runbook + cost breakdown link in #eng-infra-docs in ~30m. Please call out any blockers now.
Mike V: none from infra side. I'll standby for the 5m netops heads-up. :thumbsup:
Anil Patel: Adding a quick perf-sanity prompt set to run post-reboot for top 10 tenants.
Laura Chen: Perfect — thanks team. We'll monitor p99 and error-rate on the console, and if anything >2x baseline for >10m we abort and roll back.
ops-bot: maintenance-updated: maint-7012468000 status=ready cohorts=10 prechecks=complete
